visualCharacteristics.purpose: equal columns of heading + bulleted list or text, separated by vertical rules

contentPattern.structure: one row; one cell per column. Each cell: optional heading, list or text, optional link. four-columns lays the row out as four columns on desktop

usage: Benefits / requirements lists and short feature columns split by rules
reuseGuidance: Use for 2-4 rule-separated text columns. Not for image + text (columns-media).
